name: encrypted_survey
description: Walk a tree and measure what was actually encrypted: which files, by what proportion, with the appended extension, the entropy at the head and across the file, the trailing bytes that often identify the family, and the clustering of modification times that brackets when the encryption ran.

sample.description: How many files to read in full for the entropy profile (default 200)

tail_bytes.description: Trailing bytes to report per sampled file (default 32)

limit.description: Preview rows returned inline when the job OUT directory can hold the complete encrypted-files.jsonl (default 200); ignored when no lossless output directory exists
